I will not put chemical fertilizer on this beans plot this season because beans do not need much nitrogen, and with my money I have to be careful about extra cost on rented land. I will plant mostly local seed and use some manure if I can get it, then rely on family work for most of the season. I expect to spray for pests because beans can suffer badly from insects here, and I will keep the plot rainfed, not irrigated.
